title: Subak window preferences, schema version 1
description: Contents of %APPDATA%\mouv\subak\gui.json, written by subak-gui (Step 16, ADR 0039, docs/SUBAK_GUI.md §5). Display preferences and window placement only: no process ids, terminal content or secrets. Unknown keys are allowed and preserved by subak-gui when it rewrites the file.

font_size.description: Terminal text size in logical pixels (size.terminal); default 13.

theme.description: auto: kim-dark, or the system colours while Windows High Contrast is on.

window.description: The restored (not maximized) outer window rectangle in physical screen pixels at dpi, and whether the window was maximized. A rectangle on no current monitor is ignored.

last_terminal.description: The Terminal shown last, reopened when it still runs (by id, else by name). A hint, never a process.

hidden_terminals.description: Terminals hidden in the window when it last ran, by id (Step 18). They keep running; the Terminal manager shows them and opening one there shows its tab again.
